description: Test suite for HTTP handlers in the Mattermost server, including security headers, CSRF protection, error handling, and request validation.

methods.name: handlerForHTTPErrors
methods.description: Handles HTTP errors by setting an AppError in the context.

methods.name: TestHandlerServeHTTPErrors
methods.description: Tests redirection behavior on error responses for different endpoints and device types.

methods.name: handlerForServeDefaultSecurityHeaders
methods.description: Sets default security headers; empty implementation in tests.

methods.name: TestHandlerServeDefaultSecurityHeaders
methods.description: Verifies security headers like Permissions-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy are set correctly.

methods.name: handlerForHTTPSecureTransport
methods.description: Handles HTTPS security transport headers; empty implementation in tests.

methods.name: TestHandlerServeHTTPSecureTransport
methods.description: Tests Strict-Transport-Security header setting based on config.

methods.name: handlerForCSRFToken
methods.description: Handles CSRF token responses; empty implementation in tests.

methods.name: TestHandlerServeCSRFToken
methods.description: Tests CSRF token handling, including success, failure, and fallback behaviors.

methods.name: handlerForCSPHeader
methods.description: Handles Content Security Policy headers; empty implementation in tests.

methods.name: TestHandlerServeCSPHeader
methods.description: Verifies CSP headers for static and non-static resources, including subpath handling and dev mode.

methods.name: TestGenerateDevCSP
methods.description: Tests generation of development CSP strings based on build mode and developer flags.

methods.name: TestHandlerServeInvalidToken
methods.description: Tests invalid token handling and cookie setting for different site URLs.

methods.name: TestHandlerServeCSRFFailureClearsAuthCookie
methods.description: Tests CSRF failure response, cookie clearing, and behavior under strict CSRF enforcement.

methods.name: TestCheckCSRFToken
methods.description: Comprehensive tests for CSRF token validation logic under various request conditions.

methods.name: TestGetOriginClient
methods.description: Tests detection of client type (web, mobile, desktop) based on User-Agent and query parameters.

methods.name: noOpHandler
methods.description: A no-operation handler used in tests.

methods.name: TestHandlerServeHTTPBasicSecurityChecks
methods.description: Tests URL length validation and request size limits, including 414 and 413 responses.

methods.name: TestHandlerServeHTTPRequestPayloadLimit
methods.description: Tests payload size limits and error responses for oversized requests.
